title: One field, sowing to harvest, carried into the next season
assumption: These are illustrative stages, not observed dates or measured growth. Winter wheat is a planning assumption for Bihor/Oradea. The partner farm's crop, variety and sowing date are not yet confirmed.

recordFormat.title: Every observation carries
recordFormat.note: Example ID format. These are not real records.

fields.label: Camera settings
fields.example: camera ID · resolution · exposure · white balance · lens height · grey-card frame

fields.label: GPS / time
fields.example: fix quality and timestamp; ‘no fix’ is recorded, never guessed

fields.label: Weather / EO provenance
fields.example: source · product · date range · retrieval date

replay.title: Weather and satellite context
replay.caveat: This is a regional reference area near Oradea and its crop is unknown. The data is not from the partner farm's parcel. It does not establish disease risk or measured crop stages.

stages.label: Seed & field records
farmer: Previous crop, tillage and soil notes
Planned sowing date and seed rate
Station plan: station IDs fixed before the season
device: Photos of the seed-lot label and station markers
Calibration frames with a grey card
GPS fix quality at each station, where available
expert: Station layout that is not biased by headlands or tramlines
Which diseases matter for this variety and region
missing: The partner farm's crop, variety and sowing date are not confirmed
Parcel boundaries are private and are never published

stages.label: Sowing
farmer: Sowing date, drill settings and seed rate
device: Photos of the seedbed surface and residue at each station
The device cannot see seeds in the soil
evidence: Sowing record linked to the station register
Weather provenance starts: source and retrieval date

stages.label: Emergence
farmer: Establishment problems such as slugs, birds or waterlogging
device: Top-down photos at stations to support plant counts
Inference runs only for classes and stages the model was evaluated on. Other images are stored for review
evidence: Visit IDs, camera settings per photo, and GPS and time where available
missing: Model coverage for seedling stages has not been established

stages.label: Tillering
device: Blurred or badly exposed frames flagged for a retake
evidence: Reviewed observations: label, reviewer, confidence, disagreement with the model
missing: The public Sentinel-2 replay has no January observation

stages.label: Stem extension
farmer: Fungicide and growth-regulator decisions, made by the farmer or advisor
Product, dose, date and operator for each intervention
device: The same leaf layer photographed at every visit
Inference with uncertainty, sent to review
expert: Decide whether any intervention is needed. QUERRA does not prescribe
evidence: Interventions linked to visits and stations
missing: Disease pressure at the partner farm is unknown

stages.label: Heading & flowering
device: Classes outside the evaluated set are stored for review, not labelled
expert: Ear diseases and head blight risk need expert and model context, not photos alone
evidence: EO provenance per visit: product, scene date and cloud share
missing: M4 risk-map integration is planned, not built

stages.label: Grain filling
farmer: Late disease, lodging and harvest planning
device: Senescence can look like disease, so these images go to review
evidence: Final reviewed observation set per station
missing: No canopy observations exist yet for the partner farm

stages.label: Harvest
farmer: Measured yield from a weighbridge or yield monitor
device: Optional photos of stubble and grain samples
The device does not measure yield
expert: Read yield next to observations without claiming cause
evidence: Measured harvest outcome linked to stations, where the resolution allows
missing: Field-level yield may not resolve to individual stations

stages.label: Next-season review
farmer: What worked, what was missed, intervention outcomes
device: No field capture; a versioned export is produced
expert: Independent review of the season dataset
evidence: Versioned export: observations, reviews, interventions, outcomes and provenance
Station register carried into next season
missing: Several seasons are needed before any agronomic model claim
